QuestInfo.name: Council President's Order 3
QuestInfo.0: Council President #bAnthony#k in #bEdelstein#k has something to tell you.
QuestInfo.1: Anthony says the budget for Edelstein is still tight, and asks you to get a DEX Crystal for him. How is a DEX Crystal going to help the city...?\n\n#i4005002##t4005002#  #b#c4005002# / 1#k
QuestInfo.2: You brought a DEX Crystal to Anthony.

0.0: Oh, it's you! I'm glad that you're here. Edelstein needs you again! ...This is for the greater good, I promise you!

yes.0: This time we need a #bDEX Crystal#k. It's not a common item, but it's necessary to secure my...er, the safety of Edelstein!

no.0: I thought you cared for the common man, but clearly I was wrong.

1.0: Yes, that's the DEX Crystal! With this, I'll be able to escape--um, help rescue the people from this dire situation! Ha! Ha! Ha...

yes.0: Edelstein thanks you. You are a hero to this city!

item.0: No, I asked for a #bDEX Crystal#k. Hmm... It's not an easy task, but if you don't do this, hundreds of puppies could get eliminated!
